plan.purpose: Determine whether the TableCheck preflight misses observed results; no B, no product fixes, no model/Google API.
plan.userRequest: Investigate further; user browser searches successfully.
plan.actions: Navigation and passive observation only. No click, fill, reservation or form submission. Plain mode blocks all writes and admits only matching browser GET preflight.
plan.controls: Production is the actual unchanged source-data preflight with passive hooks. Guarded/plain share fresh headless isolated context, blocked ServiceWorkers, URL and deadlines. Guarded policy is unchanged.
plan.interpretation: Positive results now do not rewrite historical failures. A result visible before closure with missing count implicates observation. Positive after20s supports early-close mechanism. Sequential single-page contrasts are diagnostic, not causal or capability acceptance.
